report.what: Head coach Mike LaFleur said Wednesday that the Cardinals will evaluate Love (ankle) again Monday to hone in on a return date for the running back, Bo Brack of GoPHNX.com reports.. Love must miss at least one more game due to the right high-ankle sprain that he picked up in a Week 8 win at Dallas, but the Cardinals have a decision to make next week, as they have a Week 13 matchup with the Eagles on tap before a Week 14 bye. For as long as Love is sidelined, Tyler Allgeier and Bam Knight will continue to man Arizona's backfield.

alerts.body: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison will be listed as a non-participant on Wednesday's injury report, Ben…

report.what: Head coach Kevin O'Connell said Addison will be listed as a non-participant on Wednesday's injury report, Ben Goessling of the Minnesota Star Tribune reports.. Addison is in recovery mode from the thumb injury that required surgery following a Nov. 15 practice, missing the last two games as a result. While an IR stint has been ruled out for Addison, O'Connell relayed Monday that the wide receiver is "progressing really well" but also isn't expected to play Sunday against the Falcons, according to Goessling. As long as Addison is sidelined, some combination of Jauan Jennings, Tai Felton and Myles Price will operate alonside top WR Justin Jefferson.

Though Walker was able to log a limited practice Tuesday, he was listed as a non-participant Wednesday and will wind up missing a third straight contest while he continues to nurse a sore groin. With Walker sidelined, rookie Emmett Johnson is set for another turn as the Chiefs' lead back, with Jaydn Ott serving as his top backup and Nate Carter a possible practice-squad elevation.
